notes: The parts list says 82 ohm but the schematic labels the resistor 220 ohm; 82 was used as listed in the parts list.
Breadboard hole names use the catalogue convention (bank 'b' = rows f-j). The image's upper half is labelled f-j, so those holes are written as '<col>b.<row>'.

The resistor sits in row h from column 3 to column 6. The green wire from pin 2 ends in column 3 (row g). The LED's bent, longer leg (anode) is in column 6 and its straight leg (cathode) is in column 8. The black GND wire is in column 8 (row h).
The micro USB cable (power/programming) and the Arduino IDE are not part of the circuit graph. The usb-cable catalogue entry has no ports, so no USB edge was added.
Jumper wires are modelled with ends 'a' and 'b'. The wire to the MKR header was taken as a plain jumper-wire inserted into the header pin.
The sketch reads A1, but nothing is connected to it.
